python3 - <<'PY'
import redis,collections
s=redis.Redis(port=6379);c=collections.Counter();meta=collections.Counter()
for k in s.scan_iter():
 if s.type(k)!=b'stream':continue
 info=s.xinfo_stream(k);groups=s.xinfo_groups(k)
 for g in groups:
  c['groups']+=1;c['pending']+=g['pending'];c['consumers']+=g['consumers'];c['empty_groups']+=not g['consumers'];c['none_entries_read']+=g['entries-read'] is None
 meta['streams']+=1
 meta['entries added difference']+=info['entries-added']-info['length']
 print(k,'entries',info['length'], 'added',info['entries-added'],'max-del',info['max-deleted-entry-id'],'groups',[(g['name'],g['pending'],g['entries-read']) for g in groups]);
print(c,meta)
PY
valkey-cli -p 6380 COMMAND INFO XGROUP\|SETID | head -20
